selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: In this warning, who is being spoken to?
questions.answer: The person’s own nafs, or lower self.

questions.question: What wrong idea makes the nafs feel bored with worship?
questions.answer: It acts like life will last a very long time.

questions.question: Does the passage say a person can prove they will live until tomorrow?
questions.answer: No. A person has no sure proof of that.

questions.question: What does the warning teach about life in this world?
questions.answer: Life is short and goes away quickly.

questions.question: How much time out of one day is spoken about for worship?
questions.answer: One hour out of twenty-four.

questions.question: What kind of deed is that hour of worship called?
questions.answer: A good, easy, gentle act of serving Allah.

questions.question: What can this worship help a person gain?
questions.answer: Real happiness in the life that lasts forever.

questions.question: What is a wise way to think about worship after reading this warning?
questions.answer: To do it happily and with energy.

questions.question: What is the main lesson of the First Warning?
questions.answer: Do not get tired of worship, because life is short and important.

questions.question: What question is asked to make the nafs think about life?
questions.answer: Whether its life will last forever.

questions.question: Why is acting as if we will stay here forever a mistake?
questions.answer: Because our life can end soon.

questions.question: What feeling comes from forgetting that life is short?
questions.answer: Boredom with worship.

questions.question: What happens when life is spent in a useless way?
questions.answer: It passes away without good benefit.

questions.question: Is the daily worship described as hard or manageable?
questions.answer: It is described as manageable and pleasant.

questions.question: What does the warning say that hour of worship leads toward?
questions.answer: Lasting joy in the next life.

questions.question: What feeling is better than boredom when doing worship?
questions.answer: Cheerful eagerness and pleasure.

questions.question: In the passage, what is the nafs pretending about life in the world?
questions.answer: That it will keep living here for a very long time.

questions.question: What two times are mentioned to show we do not know how long we will live?
questions.answer: Next year and even tomorrow.

questions.question: Why should a person not waste life?
questions.answer: Because life is brief and is slipping away.

questions.question: What small part of the day is given to worship in this warning?
questions.answer: One hour.

questions.question: How is the act of worship described in a kind way?
questions.answer: It is called good, pleasing, easy, and full of mercy.

questions.question: What reward is connected to this act of worship?
questions.answer: True happiness that never ends.

questions.question: What change should happen in the heart when a person understands this message?
questions.answer: Boredom should turn into joy and wanting to worship.

questions.question: What feeling should replace boredom after understanding the warning?
questions.answer: Strong interest and happy willingness.
